symptom: `refresh catalog full source` under `go test -race` reports two DATA RACEs in getModulesFromCache/findModule (helpers.go), reached from describeEntity in the catalog's parallel describe workers
cause: executorCache.modules is filled lazily with no synchronisation; the catalog runs captureDescribeParallel from a goroutine pool sharing one ExecContext.Cache, and preWarmCache warmed the hierarchy and name maps but not the module list, so several workers each listed the modules and published the slice while others read the field
fix: Fill and invalidate the module list under executorCache.modulesMu; the page builder's getModules goes through the same cachedModules
insight: The race detector only reports a location pair once per process, so a -race test run with -count>1 passes on later iterations even against the unfixed code; pair it with a detector-free assertion (ListModules called once by N concurrent lookups on a slow mock). Driving the whole `refresh catalog full source` under -race also surfaces a separate race inside the ANTLR Go runtime's shared DFA (page/workflow describes parse expressions concurrently), so the regression test drives entity describes only
